title: Sample motor policy

scenarios.question: Is depreciation on new parts covered?
Car stolen — do you get the invoice price?
What is your car insured for?

items.label: Insured value (IDV)
items.why: The most you get if the vehicle is stolen or a total loss.

items.label: Own-damage premium
items.why: The part of your premium for your own vehicle.

items.label: Deductible
items.why: The part of each claim you pay yourself.

items.label: No-claim bonus
items.why: Discount on renewal for claim-free years.

sections.title: Third-party liability
sections.subtitle: Injury or damage you cause to others (mandatory by law)

items.label: Third-party cover
items.why: Required by law to drive on Indian roads.

sections.title: Add-ons
sections.subtitle: Extra covers that close common claim gaps

items.label: Zero depreciation
items.why: Without it, you pay for wear on replaced parts.

items.label: Engine protection
items.why: Covers engine damage from water or oil leaks, which a basic policy excludes.

items.label: Return to invoice
items.why: Pays the invoice price, not the depreciated value, on theft or total loss.

items.label: Consumables
items.why: Nuts, bolts, oil and coolant used in repairs.

items.label: Roadside assistance
items.why: Towing, flat tyre and fuel help on the road.

items.label: Normal wear and tear
items.why: Listed as an exclusion in your policy.

items.label: Driving under the influence
items.why: Listed as an exclusion in your policy.

items.label: Driving without a valid licence
items.why: Listed as an exclusion in your policy.
